dexamethasone (0.1, 0.5, 1, 5 nM for 1 hour) and two untreated A549 RNA tracks.

K7 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
LEAKAGE. Borzoi saw A549 dexamethasone RNA-seq in training. K2 and K5 cannot
separate prediction from recall, and no gate here claims they can. Only K4's sham
control and the dose and time mismatch argue against pure recall.
Borzoi's own folds are assigned by genomic REGION and this loop does not restrict
to held-out regions, so most genes scored here were very likely in its training
data. Restricting to fold-held-out regions is the honest zero-shot test and is not
done here.
300 genes were scored, not the full set, so every number carries that subset's
sampling error; the curated arm is rescored on the same genes to match.
